sources.supportingExcerpt: obtain an instant tourist eVisa through integrated travel packages offered by qualified travel agencies.

policies.title: Saudi Arabia: Visa by Package ordinary passports with tourist eVisa
policies.summary: The current Saudi Tourism Authority country dataset assigns Bangladesh, Egypt, India, Indonesia, Jordan, Mexico, and Pakistan to “Visa by Package”; the corresponding live route expressly issues an instant tourist eVisa through approved integrated travel packages.
conditions: This narrow nationality group is a package-conditioned tourist eVisa route, not an unconditional eVisa or visa-free result. The live route calls it an instant tourist eVisa through travel packages offered by qualified agencies.

The required package includes a confirmed Ministry of Tourism-licensed four-star-or-higher hotel booking, confirmed round-trip flight, completed online visa application and medical insurance. The route limits a package to nine tourists aged over 18.

The route specifies a minimum package price of SAR 4,000 per adult for the first two days plus SAR 1,000 per extra day, a two-to-88-day package duration, travel beginning at least 48 hours after purchase, and destinations excluding Makkah and Madinah. It describes a single-entry visa valid three months from travel start.

The separate U.S./UK/Schengen visa or permanent-residence routes, GCC-resident eVisa route, generic embassy route, visa on arrival, transit/stopover route, GCC citizenship, work, study, residence, Hajj, special passports and final immigration admission are not normalized by this policy.

application.label: Visit Saudi Package Visa service
steps: Book a compliant visa-inclusive package with an approved provider through the official Visit Saudi Package Visa service.
Provide the required hotel and round-trip-flight booking details and complete the online visa application with medical insurance.
Wait for the issued tourist eVisa before travel and present it with the required package and travel documents for border examination.
